name: YouTube transcripts
description: Gets the captions of a YouTube video for "New note from a transcript". Asks YouTube for the video's caption list and downloads one track (the video's own language, written by a person if there is one, else the automatic one). Talks to www.youtube.com only. YouTube does not offer this for outside use and can change it at any time; if it stops working, an update of this extension fixes it.
author: Notation
